1.summary: Your next attack receives +10 to the combat check.

2.summary: Reduce opponent Armor by -1 in struck location until end of combat.

4.summary: You are immune to all conditions until your next turn, including current ones.

5.summary: Your opponent immediately suffers 1 Piercing damage that ignores Armor.

6.summary: Add +D6 to your Damage Pool for your next attack.

7.summary: You gain Advantage on your next attack.

8.summary: Your opponent's next defensive check is reduced by -20.

10.summary: Your next specific-body-part attack ignores usual Disadvantage.

1.summary: Creature next attack gains +10 Combat Skill; if magical, PC Spellward is -10 until creature's next turn.

2.summary: Reduce PC Armor by -1 in struck location until end of combat.

4.summary: Creature clears all current negative conditions.

5.summary: PC receives 1 Piercing damage that ignores Armor.

6.summary: Creature next damaging Action gains +D6 damage; if non-damaging, PC Spellward is -10 until creature's next turn.

7.summary: Creature gains Advantage on next attack; if magical, PC rolls Spellward with Disadvantage.

8.summary: PC next Dodge, Parry, or Spellward check is reduced by -20.

10.summary: Creature gets a new turn immediately.
